description: OpenRig is an open-source multi-agent harness: define a team of Claude Code and Codex agents in YAML, boot it with the rig CLI, and coordinate the agents through tmux sessions, a durable queue and a local daemon.
rules: Install with npm install -g @openrig/cli. OpenRig requires Node.js 20, 22 or 24 and tmux; the first-project starter also requires an authenticated Codex CLI.
Preview before launching: rig specs preview <spec>, then rig up <spec> --cwd . --plan, then rig up <spec> --cwd .
Check seat readiness with rig ps --nodes --rig <rig>, not only daemon health from rig status.
Inside a rig, an agent runs rig whoami --json first and treats its output as its identity.
rig send <session> "message" types into a peer's terminal and presses Enter; rig capture <session> reads that peer's screen.
Work another agent must act on goes in the queue (rig queue create or rig queue handoff); a message informs but does not assign work.
Use rig start to bring rigs back after a reboot or daemon restart.
Run rig --help for the current command surface; the CLI is authoritative over older examples.
